correctness.rationale: Laszlo–Pauly ordinary genus-two theta formulas give four nonzero-scaled quadrics P0=sum x_i^2, P01=x00*x01+x10*x11, P10=x00*x10+x01*x11, P11=x00*x11+x01*x10. Over char2 P0=(sum x_i)^2; the cross-equation sums, together with the sum-zero relation, force all projective coordinates equal at any geometric zero. On chart x00=1 set x01=1+a,x10=1+b,x11=1+c,s=a+b+c. The ideal is exactly J=(s^2,s+bc,s+ac,s+ab). Setting s=ab=ac=bc and c=a+b+ab, the relation ac=ab gives a^2(1+b)=0, while bc=ab gives b^2(1+a)=0; the local units force a^2=b^2=0. Conversely substituting c=a+b+ab and a^2=b^2=0 annihilates J. Hence the local quotient is exactly k[a,b]/(a^2,b^2), with basis 1,a,b,ab, maximal-ideal Hilbert series 1+2t+t^2 and regular sequence c+a+b+ab,a^2,b^2. Independently computed a GF(2) Groebner basis for the four polynomials, recovering the same complete intersection (a^2,b^2,c+a+b+ab), not relying only on source verifier logs.
residual_risks: Relies on the prior identification of the geometric quadrics and nonzero coordinate scalars for ordinary genus-two curves; no nonordinary or odd-prime extension.

final_claim: For an ordinary smooth genus-two curve over algebraically closed characteristic-two field, the scheme-theoretic base locus of the theta-coordinate Verschiebung rational map is the unique point (1:1:1:1), with local ring k[a,b]/(a^2,b^2), length four, Hilbert function (1,2,1) and local complete-intersection structure.
limitations: Ordinary smooth genus two over algebraically closed characteristic two only.
